name: The Farmer
summary: Meet the settler who farms by the crash site.

steps.text: Talk to the farmer at his stall by the shack, northwest of the wreck.

dialogue.speaker: Logbook
dialogue.text: Life signs at a shack northwest of the wreck. One settler. Friendly.

outro.speaker: Farmer
outro.text: Walked out of that wreck on your own feet? Well, I'll be. Here, eat something, and take some seed and scrap.

outro.speaker: Farmer
outro.text: The colony left Workshops all over these hills. Get one running and you can build near anything. I've marked the nearest on your map.
